title: sdeveng evidence item v1
description: An attributable, expandable piece of evidence anchored to a canonical repository location key.

id.description: Stable evidence identifier: evidence: followed by the lowercase SHA-256 digest of the canonical item identity.

locationKey.description: Canonical repository location key in the RepositoryLocationKey format, optionally narrowed to an escaped symbol.

content.description: Expandable evidence payload; values may be added without changing the evidence envelope.
